---
title: "Suppinger gastruloids"
---

Single-cell UMI counts and bulk HTSeq tables from the murine gastruloid
resource of Suppinger and colleagues (*Cell Stem Cell*, 2023; GEO
[GSE229513](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE229513)
and
[GSE229386](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE229386);
[@suppingerMultimodalCharacterizationMurine2023]). Download commands
belong in `data/raw/README.md`. Never overwrite `data/raw/`.

The scRNA-seq experiment is **one** technical 10x Chromium 3′ v3
resource, not a panel of independent biological replicates for GRNs or
for `DESeq2`. Zeros are molecule-sampling counts until proven otherwise
(@nte-drop-zico). GSE250136 is a later stem-embryo dataset and must not
be conflated with Suppinger.

## Hierarchical design {#sec-geo-design}

The native hierarchy is the same idea as a barcode-nested gastruloid
atlas (morphotype $\to$ sample $\to$ cells), but the factors here are
**cell line** and **time**, not TLS versus neural-bias organoids.

![Luque-style nested design (morphotype $\to$ barcode $\to$ cells). We
keep the hierarchy and change the factors to Suppinger's cell lines and
time slots.](images/luque_vaillaronage_factorial_desig_to_reproduce.png){#fig-luque-nest}

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-suppinger-design
%%| fig-cap: "Suppinger hierarchy. Single-cell: cell line at the top, ordinal time slots below. Bulk RNA-seq: Wnt schedule at the top, three biological replicates at each of 48 h, 72 h and 96 h. Gene networks are learned only on the three bulk-matched times, independently per cell type."
%%{init: {"theme": "sandstone", "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": true}}}%%
flowchart TD
  SC["scRNA-seq GSE229513"] --> L1["Cell line B-S"]
  SC --> L2["Cell line SBR"]
  L1 --> Tsc["Ordinal times 0–120 h"]
  L2 --> Tsc
  Tsc --> Both["Both lines only at 48 h"]
  BULK["Bulk RNA-seq GSE229386"] --> W1["Standard Wnt pulse at 48 h"]
  BULK --> W2["Early Wnt pulse at 24 h"]
  W1 --> R1["48 h, 72 h, 96 h × 3 replicates"]
  W2 --> R1
  GRN["GGMs for DeCovarT"] --> TP["Independently at 48 h, 72 h, 96 h"]
  TP --> CT["One $$\\widehat{\\boldsymbol{\\Theta}}_{j,t}$$ per labelled type"]
```

**Single-cell (GSE229513).** Top level: the mESC line (B-S versus SBR).
Bottom level: the ordinal time slots of gastruloid development. The
integrated Seurat object spans all times (@fig-seurat-workflow). Cell
line is **confounded with time**: only 48 h has both lines; every other
slot is a single line, and that line changes across the series. We
therefore **do not** put cell line in the GRN design. Developmental
trajectories of B-S and SBR are treated as equivalent for the purpose
of type-level Gaussians (@fig-bio-space).

**Bulk RNA-seq (GSE229386).** Top level: the Wnt schedule — standard
pulse at 48 h (control-like gastruloids) versus a premature pulse at
24 h (early treatment). Bottom level: **three biological replicates**
at each of 48 h, 72 h and 96 h.

**GRN restriction.** We learn an undirected GGM **independently** for
each labelled cell type $j$ at each time $t\in\{48,72,96\}\,\mathrm{h}$
for which a bulk sample exists. We do not share graphs across time, and
we do not estimate a cell-line effect.

## Seurat processing {#sec-seurat}

Embeddings, QC and clustering for the atlas follow the Seurat workflow
in @fig-seurat-workflow (Alevin counts, `scater` QC, `SCTransform`
Pearson residuals **per batch** for integration, CCA, PCA, UMAP,
Louvain). That residualisation is for **integration and visualisation**.
It is not the observation table of the graphical lasso
(@sec-grn-observation, @sec-fs-hvg).

![Seurat workflow used to extract embeddings and downstream analyses on
GSE229513.](images/suppinger_seurat_workflow_single_cell.png){#fig-seurat-workflow}

Templates:
[`01_01_single_cell_exploration_suppinger.R`](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/GastroDeconv2FateMap/blob/main/scripts/01_01_single_cell_exploration_suppinger.R)
and
[`02_01_deconvolution_preprocessing.R`](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/GastroDeconv2FateMap/blob/main/scripts/02_01_deconvolution_preprocessing.R);

## Biological interpretation from single-cell compositions {#sec-bio-sc}

@fig-bio-lineage and @fig-bio-space summarise a **putative** reading of
annotated type proportions along gastruloid time. They are not a
reconstruction of embryonic lineages. Two annotated states are treated
as technical artefacts of culture stress. The working caudal sequence
after the Chir/Wnt pulse is pluripotency $\to$ epiblast $\to$ primitive
streak $\to$ caudal mesoderm / NMP $\to$ pre-somitic mesoderm / somites,
with a residual endoderm bias typical of gastruloids.

![Putative lineage reading of Suppinger annotations (disclaimer: not a
ground-truth DAG).](images/suppinger_biological_itepreation.png){#fig-bio-lineage}

![Spatial / time-slot sketch of type composition, including the B-S and
SBR series.](images/suppinger_biological_itepreation_2.png){#fig-bio-space}

## Deconvolution-guided reading of early versus standard Wnt {#sec-bio-deconv}

Second-generation mean-based deconvolution (BayesPrism, SCDC, DWLS) on
the bulk series is used only as a **compositional narrative**, not as
DeCovarT's covariance model. @fig-bio-early contrasts a standard Wnt
pulse at 48 h with a premature pulse at 24 h, at the three bulk-matched
times.

![Deconvolution-guided comparison of standard versus early Wnt
gastruloids at 48 h, 72 h and 96 h.](images/deconvolution-guided_biological_interpeation_elarly_treatment.pdf){#fig-bio-early}

On the **control-like** arm, 72 h is primitive-streak enriched and 96 h
shows pre-somitic mesoderm and somite progression. On the **early Wnt**
arm, 48 h retains more naïve pluripotency, 72 h is dominated by ectopic
pluripotency with a reduced primitive streak, and 96 h nearly loses PSM.
Absolute abundances disagree across algorithms — weighted least squares
is sensitive to collinearity among neighbouring states — so we treat
**direction of change** (ectopic pluripotency up, primitive streak and
PSM down) as the consensus, not the point estimates.

That is why GRNs are fit **per type and per time** at 48 h, 72 h and
96 h: those are the slots where a bulk composition exists to confront
the Gaussians. Cell line remains out of the precision model
(@sec-geo-design).
